name: Huitz’Plina
body:
HUITZ’PLINA
CR 3

XP 800
NG Medium magical beast
Init +3; Senses darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +9

DEFENSE

AC 15, touch 13, flat-footed 12 (+3 Dex, +2 natural)
hp 30 (4d10+8)
Fort +6, Ref +7, Will +2

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft., climb 20 ft.
Melee spear +4 (1d8/×3 P)
Ranged longbow +7 (1d8/×3 P, range incr. 100 ft.)
Special Attacks spine assault (2d6+4 P, DC 14 half)

STATISTICS

Str 11 (+0); Dex 17 (+3); Con 14 (+2); Int 12 (+1); Wis 13 (+1); Cha 10 (+0)
Base Atk +4; CMB +4; CMD 17
Feats Nimble Moves, Skill Focus (Acrobatics)
Skills Acrobatics +13, Climb +8, Perception +9, Stealth +10
Languages Common, Huitz’plina
SQ predreaming, prehensile tail

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Predreaming (Su)

Once per day, a huitz’plina can spend a standard action to receive a hazy vision related to the outcome of an event, goal, or activity as far as a day into the future. This otherwise functions as augury with a 100% chance of successfully receiving a meaningful reply.

Prehensile Tail (Ex)

Huitz’plinas have long, flexible tails that can be used to carry objects. They cannot wield weapons with their tails, but they can retrieve small, stowed objects carried on their persons as a swift action.

Spine Assault (Ex)

Once per day, after a huitz’plina takes the total defense action and before the start of their next turn, they can as an immediate action launch a barrage of spines in a 20-foot radius spread centered on themself. Every other creature in the area must succeed at a Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 the huitz’plina’s Hit Dice + the huitz’plina’s Constitution modifier) or take piercing damage equal to 2d6 plus the huitz’plina’s Hit Dice; a successful save halves this damage.

ECOLOGY

Environment warm forests
Organization solitary, pair, or prickle (3–4)
Treasure standard (longbow with 20 arrows, spear, other gear)

The huitz’plinas are a species of magical creature with the gift of foresight, allowing them to glimpse into the future. This has allowed them to develop their own culture and become an important species in the Galaxy despite what appears to be a primitive culture.

Roughly the size and shape of chimpanzees, huitz’plinas are notable for their long, prehensile tails and a covering of featherlike quills, which they can use defensively.

Their faces are bare save for a shock of hair on top of their heads, and they have insectlike eyes, antennae, and mandible-like growths near their mouths, which give them a distinctly alien appearance.

Despite the fact that they rarely build shelter and live in open-air communities in the trees, huitz’plinas ae deceptively intelligent.

They have very complex social structures and oral storytelling traditions. In addition, they are profoundly affected by their ability to see glimpses of the future during a state they call “predreaming.” Because of their abilities, many other species view the huitz’plinas with great suspicion and fear, and much derision is sent their way. Meanwhile, many unscrupulous agents have tried to use them as spies—with mixed results.

Huitz’plina colonies have mysteriously appeared on many forested worlds around the Galaxy, and more adventurous huitz’plinas have sought opportunities to learn more about new worlds. While they have run into prejudice at some turns, they have sometimes found others willing to give them a fair chance to prove themselves—for better or for worse.
